image_description: A vertical traffic light suspended from a horizontal wire against a blue sky with clouds. The top of the frame is obscured by green tree branches and leaves. The traffic light shows three signals: red on top, amber in the middle, and green on the bottom. The green light is illuminated. A thick black cable runs horizontally across the lower third of the image.
